publisher: Immigration Services Agency of Japan (Ministry of Justice)
raw_extract: １　包括許可（１週について２８時間以内で稼働する場合） １週について２８時間以内（教育機関の長期休業期間にあっては、１日について８時間以内）の収入を伴う事業を運営する活動（注）又は報酬を受ける活動を行う場合は、資格外活動の包括許可が必要となります。 … 【必要書類】・申請書のみ
research_notes: The page is served by the Immigration Services Agency of Japan. The English-locale request returned the Japanese original of the 'Student' status of residence permission page; the verbatim Japanese above is the operative text. The official name of the permission is 資格外活動許可 / Permission to Engage in Activities Outside Those Permitted Under the Status of Residence Previously Granted, split into a blanket permit (包括許可, 28 hours or fewer per week) and an individual permit (個別許可). Holiday relaxation is 8 hours per day during the educational institution's long vacation. The agency page carries no effective date, so as_of is recorded as the retrieval year 2026. I did not fetch a MOFA source on the post-graduation job-seeking route, so no claim is made about that.

claims.statement: Under Japan's blanket permit for activities outside those permitted by the 'Student' status of residence, a student may work 28 hours or fewer per week.
During the educational institution's long vacation, the same blanket permit allows 8 hours per day.
